statements.select: SELECT UP_DEPT_NM, UP_DEPT_CD, DSTR_TYPE, CODE_KOR AS DSTR_TYPE_NM, NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP, NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE, NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE AS NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_SUM, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP1 + NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2 AS NOW_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP, NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE1 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2 AS NOW_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP1 + NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE1 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2 AS NOW_TOT_AMOUNT_SUM, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP1, NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE1, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP1 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE1 AS NOW_AMOUNT_SUM1, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2, NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2, NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2 AS NOW_AMOUNT_SUM2, CASE WHEN (NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100*(NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2)/(NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE) END AS NOW_AMOUNT_PERCENT2, NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP, NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE, NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE AS NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_SUM, NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP, NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE, NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE AS NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_SUM, CASE WHEN (NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100*(NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE)/(NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE) END AS NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PERCENT, ISNULL((SELECT NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2 + NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2 - PDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DSTR_MONTH WHERE TO_DATE = #preday# AND DSTR_TYPE = ZZ.DSTR_TYPE),0) AS DIFF_DAY_SUM, ISNULL((SELECT NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP + NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE - NEXT_AMOUNT_SUM FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DSTR_MONTH WHERE TO_DATE = #preday# AND DSTR_TYPE = ZZ.DSTR_TYPE),0) AS DIFF_MONTH_SUM FROM (SELECT DBO.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(VALUE_2) AS UP_DEPT_NM, VALUE_2 AS UP_DEPT_CD, CODE_ID AS DSTR_TYPE, CODE_KOR, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #nowyymm# AND ITEM_TYPE='1008253002' AND DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID),0) AS NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #nowyymm# AND ITEM_TYPE='1008253001' AND DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID),0) AS NOW_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253002') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') < #nowyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP1, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253001') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') < #nowyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE1, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253002') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #nowyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NOW_AMOUNT_PUMP2, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253001') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #nowyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NOW_AMOUNT_TUBE2, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #nextyymm# AND ITEM_TYPE='1008253002' AND DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID),0) AS NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #nextyymm# AND ITEM_TYPE='1008253001' AND DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID),0) AS NEXT_BASE_AMOUNT_TUBE, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253002') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #nextyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(C.WSO_KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_ORDER B, T_SO_WSO_AMOUNT C, (SELECT ITEM_CD, item_type from T_ITEM where ITEM_TYPE ='1008253001') D WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(C.SALES_PDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #nextyymm# AND B.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND B.SO_CD = C.SO_CD AND B.SO_SEQ = C.SO_SEQ AND B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND C.ITEM_CD = D.ITEM_CD),0) AS NEXT_TOT_AMOUNT_TUBE FROM T_CODE A WHERE A.UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' ) ZZ ORDER BY CAST(UP_DEPT_CD AS INT)

SELECT UP_DEPT_CD,dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(UP_DEPT_CD) AS UP_DEPT_NM, DSTR_TYPE,DSTR_TYPE_NM,CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE,CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP,CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM,SALES_GOAL, CASE WHEN SALES_GOAL = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100*(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM/SALES_GOAL) END AS SALES_PERCENT FROM ( select (SELECT VALUE_2 FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND CODE_ID = A.DSTR_TYPE) AS UP_DEPT_CD, dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(#up_dept_cd#) AS UP_DEPT_NM, DSTR_TYPE, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM('KOR', 'DSTR_TYPE',DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #YYYYMM# AND DSTR_TYPE = A.DSTR_TYPE),0) AS SALES_GOAL FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DSTR A
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #st_date# AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date#
AND DSTR_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND VALUE_1 = '국영')
AND DSTR_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND VALUE_1 = '해영' AND CODE_ID <> '8004011')
AND DSTR_TYPE = '8004011'
GROUP BY DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), DSTR_TYPE
AND DSTR_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND VALUE_1 = '국영')
AND DSTR_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND VALUE_1 = '해영' AND CODE_ID <> '8004011')
AND DSTR_TYPE = '8004011'
) B ORDER BY CAST(UP_DEPT_CD AS INT),DSTR_TYPE

SELECT UP_DEPT_CD,dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(UP_DEPT_CD) AS UP_DEPT_NM, DEPT_CD,DEPT_NM,CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE,CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP,CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM,SALES_GOAL, CASE WHEN SALES_GOAL = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100*(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM/SALES_GOAL) END AS SALES_PERCENT FROM ( select DBO.FN_GET_UP_DEPT_CD(DEPT_CD) AS UP_DEPT_CD, DEPT_CD, dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #YYYYMM# AND DEPT_CD = A.DEPT_CD),0) AS SALES_GOAL FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DEPT A
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #st_date# AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date#
AND DBO.FN_GET_UP_DEPT_CD(DEPT_CD) = #up_dept_cd#
GROUP BY DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), DEPT_CD
AND DBO.FN_GET_UP_DEPT_CD(DEPT_CD) = #up_dept_cd#
) B ORDER BY CAST(UP_DEPT_CD AS INT),CAST(DEPT_CD AS INT)

SELECT UP_DEPT_CD,dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(UP_DEPT_CD) AS UP_DEPT_NM, USER_CD,USER_NM,CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE,CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP,CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM,SALES_GOAL, CASE WHEN SALES_GOAL = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100*(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM/SALES_GOAL) END AS SALES_PERCENT FROM ( select DBO.FN_USER_UP_DEPT_CD(USER_CD) AS UP_DEPT_CD, USER_CD, dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = 'YONWOO' AND SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND SALES_YM = #YYYYMM# AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD),0) AS SALES_GOAL FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_USER A
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #st_date# AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date#
AND DBO.FN_USER_UP_DEPT_CD(USER_CD) = #up_dept_cd#
GROUP BY USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), USER_CD
AND DBO.FN_USER_UP_DEPT_CD(USER_CD) = #up_dept_cd#
) B ORDER BY CAST(UP_DEPT_CD AS INT),USER_CD

select
DSTR_TYPE, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM('KOR', 'DSTR_TYPE',DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DSTR
WHERE ORD_CDATE >= #st_date# AND ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date# GROUP BY DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), DSTR_TYPE
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), DSTR_TYPE
ORDER BY DSTR_TYPE

select
DEPT_CD, dbo.FN_GET_DEPT_NM(DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DEPT
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #st_date# AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date# GROUP BY DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), DEPT_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), DEPT_CD
ORDER BY DEPT_CD

select
USER_CD, dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, SUM(CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM T_STATIC_AMOUNT_USER
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= #st_date# AND DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= #ed_date# GROUP BY USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY') = #year# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYY'), USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM') = #year# + #month# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMM'), USER_CD
WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #year# + #month# + #day# GROUP BY DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), USER_CD
ORDER BY USER_CD
statements.insert:
INSERT INTO T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DSTR SELECT T1.ORD_CDATE, T1.DSTR_TYPE, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) + ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM( SELECT A.ORD_CDATE, A.DSTR_TYPE, C.ITEM_TYPE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253001' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253002' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP FROM V_IF_SALES_ORDER A INNER JOIN V_IF_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.SO_CD = B.SO_CD AND A.SO_SEQ = B.SO_SEQ INNER JOIN T_ITEM C ON B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #yyyymmdd# GROUP BY A.ORD_CDATE, A.DSTR_TYPE, C.ITEM_TYPE
) T1 GROUP BY ORD_CDATE, DSTR_TYPE order by ORD_CDATE

INSERT INTO T_STATIC_AMOUNT_DEPT SELECT T1.ORD_CDATE, T1.DEPT_CD, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) + ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM FROM( SELECT A.ORD_CDATE, A.DEPT_CD, C.ITEM_TYPE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253001' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253002' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP FROM V_IF_SALES_ORDER A INNER JOIN V_IF_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.SO_CD = B.SO_CD AND A.SO_SEQ = B.SO_SEQ INNER JOIN T_ITEM C ON B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #yyyymmdd# GROUP BY A.ORD_CDATE, A.DEPT_CD, C.ITEM_TYPE
) T1 GROUP BY ORD_CDATE, DEPT_CD

INSERT INTO T_STATIC_AMOUNT_USER SELECT T1.ORD_CDATE, (SELECT USER_CD FROM T_USER WHERE USER_SEQ = T1.USER_SEQ) AS USER_CD, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_TUBE, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) as CDATE_AMOUNT_PUMP, ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE),0) + ISNULL(SUM(T1.KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP),0) AS CDATE_AMOUNT_SUM, T1.USER_SEQ FROM( SELECT A.ORD_CDATE, A.USER_SEQ, C.ITEM_TYPE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253001' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_TUBE ,(case ITEM_TYPE when '1008253002' then SUM(B.AMOUNT) end) as KRW_AMOUNT_PUMP FROM V_IF_SALES_ORDER A INNER JOIN V_IF_SO_CNTR_AMOUNT B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.SO_CD = B.SO_CD AND A.SO_SEQ = B.SO_SEQ INNER JOIN T_ITEM C ON B.ITEM_CD = C.ITEM_CD WHERE DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(A.ORD_CDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #yyyymmdd# GROUP BY A.ORD_CDATE, A.USER_SEQ, C.ITEM_TYPE --ORDER BY A.ORD_CDATE DESC ) T1 GROUP BY ORD_CDATE, USER_SEQ
